entities.summary: Abu al-Khaṭṭāb ʻAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn ʻAbd al-Majīd, commonly known as Al-Akhfash al-Akbar was an Arab grammarian who lived in Basra and associated with the method of Arabic grammar of its linguists, and was a client of the Qais tribe. Al-Akhfash al-Akbar was a physicians & medical pioneers from Iraq. Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 0 Wikipedia editions).
